prompts: Use case: product-mockup. Create a high-resolution photorealistic editorial photograph, landscape 3:2, for a premium Mexican small-business brand identity manual. Real neighborhood grocery shop checkout in Mexico, warm natural daylight, honest ceramic tile, wooden counter, shelves of unbranded colorful packaged goods softly blurred, no people needed. Main subject: a small freestanding rectangular rigid sign on the counter. Camera perfectly frontal to sign, no skew, no perspective distortion of its front surface. Its blank deep forest green (#093227) face has exact landscape 3:2 proportions, occupies approximately central 50 percent of image width, centered horizontally at image center and vertically at 56 percent image height. Front face entirely blank, flat matte ink, no highlights across face, no lettering, no logos, no watermark. Thin cream border and subtle stand depth visible. Natural material textures, realistic restrained shadows, professional commercial photography. Leave face blank for later exact logo placement; no invented branding anywhere.

Use case: product-mockup. Photorealistic premium brand stationary photograph, landscape 3:2, true overhead flat lay on a warm cream terrazzo countertop of a real Mexican neighborhood shop. Main subject a crisp landscape business identity card in deep forest green (#093227), front exactly rectangular 3:2 ratio, not rotated, perfectly aligned with photo axes, centered around 48 percent width and 52 percent height, occupying about 48 percent of photo width. Card front completely blank solid forest green with no typography no logo no marks and minimal lighting variation. A few cream paper cards underneath offset slightly, realistic paper thickness and natural contact shadow. At right a modern phone resting on countertop, blank dark screen, at left edge a small handwritten receipt out of focus and part of a pencil. Warm daylight, premium real product photography, tactile paper texture, no 3D illustration look, no mockup UI, no invented text, no watermarks. Exact original logo will be inserted on blank main card later.
composicion: PNG original insertado como objeto independiente en el PDF; no se generó ni redibujó el logo.
